description: Source file defining the MenuContent SwiftUI view for the OpenClaw macOS app, including UI components, state management, microphone handling, and debug actions.

classes.name: AudioInputDevice
classes.description: A simple identifiable struct representing microphone input devices within MenuContent.

methods.name: loadMicrophones
methods.description: Loads available microphone devices using AVCaptureDevice Discovery, updates the microphone list, and manages microphone selection state.

methods.name: filterAliveInputs
methods.description: Filters microphone inputs to only include currently alive and connected devices.

methods.name: presentDebugResult
methods.description: Displays an alert with the result message of a debug action.

methods.name: loadBrowserControlEnabled
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the browser control enabled state from persistent store.

methods.name: saveBrowserControlEnabled
methods.description: Saves the current state of browser control enabled flag into persistent storage.

methods.name: buildAndSaveBrowserEnabled
methods.description: Builds configuration data, saves the browser enabled setting, and reports success or failure.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Requests opening a specific settings tab and focuses the app for user interaction.

methods.name: openDashboard
methods.description: Fetches configuration and opens the dashboard URL in the default web browser.

methods.name: healthStatus
methods.description: Determines the current health status label and color based on activity and health store state.

methods.name: heartbeatStatus
methods.description: Determines the status of the most recent heartbeat and control channel state.

methods.name: statusLine
methods.description: Creates a small status indicator line with a colored dot and label.
